text:
mia: Heads-up 10: pricing A/B rollout next Friday. Need final alignment on grandfathering + invoice runbook.

tolga: I'll own the migration dry-run and the CSV exports. What's our grandfathering policy again? 14 days or contract-end?

liz: Ops prefers 14-day soft grandfather for usage charges, keep committed subscription rates until contract expiry. That reduces churn risk.

mia: Agreed. Minimal customer impact is goal. Action items: 1) 14-day soft grandfather for usage; 2) subscription rates unchanged until contract end; 3) flag enterprise/reseller for manual review.

tolga: Adding safety checks to migration script: exclude contract_locked=true from auto-apply, tag manual_review where projected_delta>300. Pasting snippet: `WHERE contract_locked = false AND projected_delta < 300`

liz: Billing asks that CSV include invoice_id, customer_id, contract_line_id, old_unit_price, new_unit_price, projected_delta_usd, applied_price_version. Also include billing_region.

billing-bot: Preview generated: cohort preview id pvw_20260412_9, 15 invoices with projected_delta>300. Expires in 72h.

finance-ops: I'll run final checklist and sign off: run preview, validate CSV, create Grafana canary panel, set feature flag `pricing_v2_ab` off by default, schedule cutover window. Assigning tasks: @tolga export & dry-run, @liz canary + ops, @mia exec comms.

tolga: Dry-run CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-billing/previews/pvw_20260412_9.csv. Will DM legal for any per-contract exceptions list.

liz: Canary plan: 0.5% for 6h, then 5% for 24h if deltas < 2% total revenue. Rollback triggers: refund_rate>0.2% OR median_delta>150. I'll post Grafana link here when ready.

mia: Locking change window to Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC to avoid EMEA billing batch. CFO wants exec readout at 48h.

billing-bot: Reminder: preview pvw_20260412_9 will expire in 72h.

finance-ops: Thanks all 10: please keep updates here. Final sign-off will be in this thread.
